Excellence in Every Layer

Why Choose DRN Plastering Co

We never settle for good enough. Whether it is a simple repair after a rewire or a hand-crafted Venetian feature wall, the aim is the same: a finish that is sound underneath and looks the part.

  • The Highest Standards

    We treat every wall as if it were in our own home, from the first coat to the final trowel.

  • A Clean Site, Every Time

    Floors are protected, the workspace is kept tidy and the only thing left behind is the new surface.

  • Hand-Crafted Finishes

    Polished, textured and colour-matched plaster, applied by hand so no two walls are quite the same.

  • Homes and Businesses

    Single rooms, full refurbishments and commercial fit-outs all get the same attention to detail.

  • Local to Wishaw

    Based in Wishaw, so we are quick to respond across North Lanarkshire, Glasgow and the Central Belt.

About Us

The Team Behind DRN Plastering Co

DRN Plastering Co is a Wishaw plastering business working for homeowners, interior designers and commercial contractors across North Lanarkshire, Glasgow and the wider Central Belt. What began as a commitment to mastering traditional plastering has grown into a full surface finishing service, taking in Venetian plaster and microcement alongside skimming, repairs and media walls.

The approach has not changed. Careful preparation, quality materials, a tidy site and a finish we would be happy to live with ourselves. We are proud to be a North Lanarkshire business, and to see our work in homes and businesses in our own community.

Darren DenholmDirector, DRN Plastering Co
